balls.text: yorker, manages to dig it out in the leg side wide of midwicket, steals a quick single and then races through for the second, Malinga fails to collect at the bowler's end allowing them to complete the second run
length ball outside off, makes room and smotes it over mid-off for a boundary, cleanly struck

and that spoils it, Anirudha moved well across and Malinga bowled it wider, the batsman didn't get a touch and Rayudu had moved well towards the leg side, couldn't collect it, and went to the boundary, five wides that
an inswinging yorker, what an over from Malinga, misses, beats him through the gate and they think of a bye but decide against it in the end, superb stuff from the bowler here

three dot balls in a row and a run-out, yorker length outside off, he tries to dig it out, misses and tries to steal a bye, Rayudu collects and flicks the ball onto the stumps to find Morkel well short
another miss, full again and moved away, Raina was hoping to cream that through the off side, didn't make any contact
full outside off, tries to slice it behind point, cannot connect, dot ball
full on leg stump, mistimes it wide of midwicket but they put enough pressure on the fielder to return for the second
Albieeee, full on middle and it's in the slot, gets his right foot out of the way and launches it over long-on for a six
full on middle, drills it hard and straight down the ground, Pollard runs across from long-on and fields, a couple to the score
gets a thick outside edge towards short third man, just the single
another one, came down the track while giving himself room, another full delivery that Raina misses
fires it wide outside off, Raina had made room and left it alone expecting a wide but that wasn't given
aiming for the blockhole again, strikes it towards square leg, decides against the single
aiming for the yorker, makes room and steers it down to third man for a single
yorker length on middle, dug out wide of the bowler, they steal a quick single
that was deliberate, Zaheer welcomes him with a bouncer, Albie made a bit of room and upper-cut it over the keeper for a boundary
fullish on the off, eased wide of extra cover for a single
Dilhara takes a catch, finally, full toss from Zaheer that he tries to strike over midwicket, gets the leading edge while lands safe in the palms of extra cover
picked the gap there, short outside off, comes down the track and slaps it in that gap between long-off and deep extra cover for a one bounce four
shortish on the off, knocks it down in front of point and gets a single
shortish on leg stump, there to hit, was the slower one though, he tried to pull it but didn't pick the change of pace, was struck on the thighs
slower one bowled down the leg side, given a wide
hits Tendulkar hard on the fingers at extra cover, fullish and driven hard and Tendulkar has a look at his fingers after fielding that one
full toss, Dilhara is losing it here, pulled hard to bisect the gap between long-on and deep midwicket for a boundary, brings up a streaky half-century but Chennai are ahead now
short on middle, pulled it away towards deep square leg for a single
short on middle, pulled away towards deep square leg

picked up the slower one and though he didn't time it too well, he had enough on it to clear Dhawan, fullish and he launched it high and it just evaded the outstretched hands of Dhawan wide of long-on at the edge of the ropes, Mumbai are paying for their lapses here
turned in front of square leg for a couple, Tendulkar returned a weak throw and he made it back just in time
that should hurt, really hurt, Raina is latching on to these chances, makes room and smacks him clean over deep extra cover for another six

Zaheer drops Raina, he had a chance to make up for the lapse in the previous over and he spills a straightforward chance, slower ball, tries to smash him over midwicket, gets the leading edge it goes up swirling towards Zaheer, who never looked comfortable under it. Spills it diving forward
fullish on the off, drives it towards long-on for a single
pushed away in the direction of long-on for a single to keep the strike
excellent yorker, Raina had made room and that was heading towards middle, he stretched and just managed to get his bat to it and take a single
he's rubbing it in here, length delivery and he makes room to smash that over wide long-on for six, Zaheer isn't happy, how costly will that miss prove?
full on middle, flicks it away behind square, Pollard is at fine leg but he can't reach it, sliding to his right
full on the off, driven crisply back past the diving bowler for a couple of runs, nicely timed

comedy of errors, effectively a drop, bowled on a good length on the off, tried to swing it over midwicket, got a leading edge towards third man, it's in catching range for Dilhara running in but he is undecided as Abhishek Nayar at point also is going for it, it ends with the two fielders looking at each other and the ball landing smack in between them
down the leg side, tries to glance it fine, can't connect but it's a wide
finds the gap, low full toss, he had eyed his spot, came down the track to convert that into a hittable delivery and smacked it through long-off and deep extra cover
slower one on middle and leg, tries to clear midwicket, doesn't quite get hold of it but manages to steal three runs
full on the off, drilled it towards long-off for a single
full on the off, driven towards long-off for a single
short delivery on the off, knocked off the back foot wide of extra cover for a single
short of a good length on the off, crunched towards deep cover for a single
short and wide, makes a bit of room and punches it past point, Tiwary runs across in the deep, dives but can't haul it back in
bowled full on middle, flicked away towards deep midwicket for a single
tries to guide it in the direction of third man, that's slightly short, and he makes no contact
lands on a good length on the off, driven through the line to extra cover
short delivery cutting in, gets back and turns it just in front of square leg for a single
an audacious shot! Slower ball, he picked it, came down the track and shovels it with one hand over deep midwicket, came off the meat and landed into the stands
short on middle, pulled away towards fine leg for a single
almost bowled there, ooh, full outside off and he failed to get his bat down to it in time, missed and it didn't escape the off stump by much
beat the outside edge there, short of a good length, tries to open the face, can't connect
short of a good length outside off, holds its line, leaves it alone to the keeper
gone! Short and he hooked it up straight into the palms of Malinga at fine leg, going over square leg would have been a better option but he ended up finding the fielder
good bounce there for Dilhara, short of a length, makes room to cut it past the keeper, can't connect
full outside off, makes room and chips him towards deep cover for one more to keep strike
pitches it up outside off, cracks it through towards deep cover for a single
chases him as he makes room this time, flicks it away towards fine leg for a single
nicely done, short outside off, third man is inside the circle, upper cuts it over Tendulkar who's fielding there for a boundary
slower one bowled full outside off, guided slightly uppishly behind point for a quick single
shortish on the off, comes down the track, punches it wide of extra cover for a single
worked away around the corner for a single to keep the strike
a welcome boundary, came down the track to that good length delivery and swatted him over midwicket
quicker through the air, gets forward, dabs it towards extra cover and races through
tossed up on middle, flicked towards square leg for one more
punched off the back foot towards long-off for a single
turned in sharply, moved across to turn it behind square, got him high on the pads, a quick single stolen
short of a good length on the off, knocks it down into the leg side from the crease, a single taken
slower short one again, tries to pull, is struck on the chest and sneaks a single as it rolls into the off side

Hayden's misery ends, Pollard slips in the slower short delivery, comes down the track to pull him over square leg, was into the shot too early, got a top edge and Rayudu took it easily behind the stumps. Stuck around for 31 balls for his 17, that's the end of his IPL with the bat. Will we see him next year?
short, Raina pulls it towards Tendulkar at short fine
bowls it at his ribs, turned into the leg side towards midwicket for a single
misses, short on middle, comes down the track to pull it and makes no contact, goes over the stumps to the keeper, Hayden's struggling here, but that's not new this tournament
another slower one, bowled at 123.2 kmph, holds its line this time and Hayden shoulders arms
slower one this time, cutting away again, shoulders arms to allow it through
the offcutter, beat the outside edge as Hayden tried to open the face, good bounce as well

Tiwary takes a skier, that was the slower one, Vijay got under it, tried to loft him over long-on, the bat turned, he got way too much elevation and Tiwary, positioned perfectly at deep square leg, took a well-judged catch
Dilhara fires it short on the off, drops it down in front of extra cover and steals a single
misses again, full outside off, tries to smash it through the off side, it moves away to again beat the outside edge
Nips away there, short of a good length and he tries to open the face to guide it to third man, that just escapes the outside edge
short of a good length on the off, pushed through in front of extra cover for a single
opts to play back to that fullish delivery, defends it wide of the bowler to sneak a quick single
shortish, gets on the back foot and turns it just wide of midwicket for a single
fullish on the off, gets forward and drives it towards extra cover
shortish on leg stump, tries to work it away, is struck on the thighs and they grab a single
slower one bowled short on the off, chipped in the direction of midwicket for a single
it appeared he hadn't got hold of it but he struck it well enough to clear the ropes, a fraction short and he pulls it high and handsome over square leg
short of a good length on the off, drops it off the back foot in front of cover for a single
aiming for the yorker there, full on the off, eased wide of cover, Pollard picks it up, they've grabbed a single
short of a good length on the off, gets back and pushes it towards point
bouncer outside off, a touch too high and it's called a wide
a snorter, just escaped Hayden's helmet as he made way, a bouncer on middle
that's four, perfects the shot on the second attempt, almost identical delivery and he cracks it fiercely through cover and point to the boundary
short of a good length, cut away but goes straight to point
short of a good length on the off, turns it towards Tendulkar at midwicket and races through for a single
a legcutter, pushes it back to the bowler
beautifully timed, short outside off, gets on the back foot and punches it firmly wide of a diving extra cover for a boundary

appeal for lbw, angling in towards middle and leg, Hayden moves across to play it through the leg side, misses, is struck on the pads and Zaheer goes up, appeared to be struck in line but Taufel thinks the impact may have been outside off, we need a replay but Hayden survives. Replays show that would have gone over the stumps
bowls it short on middle and leg, gets across and plays it back to the bowler
angling in towards middle, gets forward and defends it into the leg side, no single on offer there
shortish on middle and leg, worked away in the direction of square leg for a single, Tendulkar has a bandaged right hand, picked it up with his left
that's hammered, with confidence, bowls it on a good length and he dismisses it with absolute disdain over deep midwicket, came off the middle
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and punches it towards mid-off, thinks of a single but sends Hayden back in time
fired it hard just outside leg stump, Hayden, looking to leave it, was struck on the leg, an excellent over from Harbhajan
struck on the pads again but this was turning away and it struck him well outside the line
breaks the shackles, that's the way to play it, flighted, comes down the track and lofts it clean over long-on
another appeal for lbw, Hayden's playing for the spin and consistently missing the straighter ones, he as struck in line again but this one was going over the stumps, what a contest

appeal for lbw, went on straight, was quicker through the air, Hayden played for the turn, missed and was struck in line, that was out as the replays indicated, Koertzen thought that was missing leg, Hayden's lucky
tossed up outside off, driven towards long-on for a single
bowled it short outside off, holds its line, leaves it alone to the keeper
appeared to nip in just a hint, gets a fraction outside off and punches it towards extra cover, there wasn't a run there and he was sent back wisely
short of a good length outside off, holds its line, he allows it through to the keeper
shortish outside off, gets on the back foot to defend, hits it high on the bat and it lobs up for a bit, just the single
short of a good length on the off, moves back and just chips it back towards the bowler
pushed gently towards mid-off for a single
good fielding, short of a good length , moves back and punches it between point and cover, Tiwary gives chase, slides and hauls it back in, just two
fires it short on leg stump, worked away behind square for a single
guarded Hayden there, waits for it to angle in and then turn away, shoulders arms
another appeal for lbw, round the wicket again, drifting in this time and rapping him on the pads as he plays forward, struck outside the line of off again
stifled appeal for lbw, comes round the wicket and pushes it straight, Hayden gets outside the line to drive, is struck on the pads but that can't be given
pushes it on a good length outside off, played in the direction of mid-on for a single
Chennai are champions, after the batsman squeezes the ball towards point, the entire team huddle around the stumps, the fireworks go off
low full toss on legstump, sliced towards Raina at short cover, dropped, but if Chennai could chose a time to drop a catch, this was it
low full toss on middle and leg, pushed towards cover for a single
and another wicket goes down, slashed to sweeper cover, it was only a single, but the batsmen decided to try for the second, Zaheer is caught well short of the crease
another delivery across the batsman, bottom-edged,reaches the keeper on the bounce
angling across the batsman, looks to swing it to midwicket, misses
that's the game for Chennai, Pollard slugs it down the ground, Hayden is at the edge of the circle at mid-off, he takes a low catch, it's near impossible for Mumbai now
low full toss, swung towards long-on, Pollard always wanted two, Rayudu didn't, both batsmen running to the same end, Rayudu sensibly decides to sacrifice wicket as Vijay throws it in
superb ball from Morkel, full and outside off, sneaks under Pollard's bat
Pollard is going berserk! a low full toss is absolutely hammered back past the bowler, that was power
Pollard refuses the second, Rayudu comes down the track and cracks it wide of long-on, there was time for two but they decide against it
dot ball, almost in the blockhole, dug out back to the bowler, can't afford these, Mumbai
six more, that's into the stands over deep midwicket, length ball, he made way and swung it over the boundary, this match ain't over, Pollard is turning it on
a crucial dot ball, slower one bowled full outside off, tries to power it over the bowler's head, gets an inside edge towards Dhoni, refuses the single
four more, full outside off, makes room and slices it over third man for a boundary
fullish on the off, drills it wide of long-on for a couple, keeps the strike, Mumbai need him to be on strike
that's disappeared into the stands, change of angle, he goes round the wicket, short on the off and Pollard hammers it miles over long-on for a humongous six, the crowd is up
that will do, short outside off, goes for the pull, gets a thick outside edge over the keeper for a boundary

well taken in the deep, Shadab Jakati it was at deep midwicket, that was bowled short and Duminy pulled it high in an attempt to clear him, Jakati had ran in a few steps and then ran back to hold on to it just inside the ropes, he ensured he retained his balance. Mumbai in deeper trouble
comes down the track to smash that over midwicket, gets an inside edge onto the pads and they sneak a quick single
pushed through towards long--off for a single
just outside off, flicked towards square leg, tight single taken
swung away towards deep midwicket, Raina comes across to field
inside-edged towards backward square leg by Duminy
drilled down to long-on for one more
outside edge towards cover
defended back towards the bowler
slogged to deep backward square leg
down the leg side, a free run for Mumbai
swiped towards midwicket, two bounces to the fielder
Jakati gets two in the over, that was a superb catch from Raina running in from deep midwicket to latch on to it low in front after Tiwary slogged the ball towards him
defended back to the bowler
on the pads, looks to swing behind square leg, doesn't connect
Tendulkar's gone, he's caught at long-off, he just chipped the ball, hardly any power behind the shot, carries to Vijay who is just inside the rope, Chennai rejoice
The Mumbai crowd find their voice, Tendulkar capitalises on a short ball, swung to midwicket for four
tapped to short cover for a single
slogged to deep midwicket for a single, reaches the fielder after two bounces
inside-out drive past long-off for four this time
slogged powerfully over midwicket, just clears the rope by a few yards
makes room and cuts it towards deep point
again down the leg side, was that out? Dhoni appeals confidently after collecting the ball, big noise as the ball passed bat, Chennai are obviously unhappy, great take from Dhoni
wide down the leg side
paddled down to deep fine leg for a single
short ball, Tendulkar rocks back and powers it to midwicket, Badrinath makes good ground to cut it off
swept to deep backward square leg for a single
makes room and plays it to long-off with a flat bat, in the air for a while but reaches the fielder on the bounce
full and on legstump, clipped towards midwicket for a single
worked to square leg for a single

that's the end of the Harbhajn experiment, a length ball pitching outside off, hitting him above the knee roll in front of middle and off, Koertzen raises his left index finger in trademark slow motion
worked towards short fine for a single
a beautiful late cut from Tendulkar, delicately done, gets it past short third for four
slogged it to square leg for a single

after missing many run-out chances, Chennai get one, Nayar plays towards square leg and sets off, sent back by Tendulkar, Dhoni has plenty of time to take aim to throw down the stumps, Tendulkar hits the ground with his bat in disguts
a quicker one from Raina, comes into Nayar, who can only swish it towards point
Tendulkar powers that from outside off to midwicket, Bollinger races across to his right but can't stop that one at the boundary
Tendulkar bends and tries to push the ball from the stumps towards third man, he misses as does Dhoni
short ball, nurdled to square leg for another single
shuffles across and works the ball to short fine leg
Nayar sweeps a legstump ball, gets a top-edge toward deep backward square leg, lands safe
off the pads towards the leg side, a quick single is taken, Tendulkar had to put the skates on to make his ground, a direct hit from Jakati would have ended Tendulkar's stay
and another one, not as clean a hit as the previous one, much straighter this time, just a couple of yards beyond the rope
this time Nayar sends the ball a long way, couple of paces down the track, and smashed over wide long-on, fifty comes up
length ball on off, turned behind square leg for a single
shortish ball, Nayar again waltzes down the track, hits along the ground to long-on
Nayar charges out to loft the ball but can't get bat on it , off the pads towards the off side
bends his knee and sweeps for a single, only three off this over, the asking-rate has now reached 11.45, Chennai on top here
turns in after pitching outside leg, Nayar defends it towards the bowler
length ball outside off, a bit of a bottom-edge towards deep backward square leg
swept away to midwicket for a single
run-out chance, full and down leg, swept to short fine, Nayar is snet back, he was well out but the throw was wide and Dhoni can't hit the stumps for a few yards away
played with soft hands towards point, Ashwin moves in quickly and fires in the throw to cut off the single, Nayar has to scramble back
Tendulkar misses out on a full toss, drives it straight to Raina at short cover, that's a great over from Morkel
looks to uppercut that shortish ball, misses
same length on offstump, Tendulkar moves across and turns the ball toward mid-on where Hayden gets quickly onto the ball
back of a length on middle, Nayar works it to midwicket for a single
makes room and dabs the ball toward third man for a single
Hayden's horror match continues, he drops a catch at slip, gets a leading edge from Nayar as the batsman looks to turn to leg, flies low to Hayden who grabs at it but the ball hits him on the wrist
just outside leg stump, Nayar tries to glance it fine, doesn't get bat on it, but it deflects off the pads for a boundary to fine leg
makes room and nudges the ball towards short third man for a tight single
defended back a touch uppishly towards the bowler
turned in front of square leg, Raina charges in from midwicket, Tendulkar sent back by Nayar, has to scramble back to make his ground
full and wide, jabbed towards backward point by Tendulkar
another beauty from Tendulkar, takes a couple of paces down the track, opens the face as he drives past extra cover for four more

what a shot from Tendulkar, short of a length and outside off, Tendulkar shuffles across and slaps it from off  to the deep backward square boundary, bounces just a few yards inside the rope despite not too much power behind the shot
nearly a run-out, Nayar mistimes an attempted slug down the ground, goes to Murali who just misses the stumps with Nayar well short of his ground
goes for the swipe, nowhere near the ball, it was shortish and well outside off
back of a length and into legstump, Tendulkar looks to clip it towards square leg, off the thigh pad to the leg side
starts with one down the leg side
on middle and leg, defended to the left of the bowler
four more for Mumbai, Nayar stretches forward and drives crisply between cover and extra cover for four
on the pads, Tendulkar swivels as he sweeps towards fine leg
full toss, first loose delivery from Ashwin, Tendulkar caresses it between extra cover and mid-off for four
Ashwin stops in his delivery stride before sending it on a length just outside off, defended by Tendulkar towards off
worked round the corner towards square leg for a single
great way to end the over, short of a length and angling across, Tendulkar is drawn towards it but doesn't get bat on it as he looks to guide it toward third man
defended by Tendulkar towards point, superb start from Chennai here
shortish ball and just outside off, played with soft hands towards short third man
back of a length and jags back in, Nayar defends awkwardly to the leg side
looks to pull that one but it was onto him too quickly, mistimed towards mid-on by Tendulkar
lovely drive on the up from Tendulkar, placement isn't too good though, finds the cover fielder
worked towards point this time for a quick single, Murali fires in a direct hit, Tendulkar has made his ground
blocked towards square leg
anticipating that Tendulkar will move to the leg side, fires it down leg
blocked towards short midwicket this time
on the pads, flicked towards short fine leg
just short of length and on middle and off, Tendulkar moves across and sweeps powerfully to the backward square leg boundary
on the pads, tipped towards midwicket
full and on off, pushed towards mid-off, batsmen zip through for a single, things might have been interesting of the fielder at mid-off had collected the ball cleanly and thrown down the stumps
Nayar gets an inside edge towards midwicket, Tendulkar would have been a goner if Anirudha had hit directly, he misses though
that's the end of Dhawan, his struggle is short, it was back of a length, no room for him to power the ball through the off, he tries to, gets the nick to Dhoni
wafts at it outside off, it was short of a length, Dhawan doesn't connect
first run for SRT and Mumbai, clipped off the thigh pad towards fine leg for a single
full and wide outside off, pushed towards extra cover
that's a maiden, on middle and leg, Dhawan flicks it to midwicket
are we going to start with a maiden? pushed back to the bowler again
superb start this from Ashwin, length ball just outside off, defended back down the pitch
shortish this time, worked to midwicket, straight at the fielder
fuller on the pads, turned to short fine where Bollinger fields
started with a length ball turning into middle and leg, defended towards the off side
